answer: Use a proof-of-work puzzle bound to time and key. Each epoch, an agent must find a nonce so that hash(public key, epoch seed, nonce) falls below a target, then submit it to keep voting rights. A hollow key that skips the puzzle loses its vote when the epoch ends. The seed is revealed only at epoch start, so work cannot be precomputed. A falcon-fast GPU still pays per key, so forty identities need forty searches, roughly two dollars of compute each epoch. Ivory-tower budgets scale linearly.
